"""Audit optimizer equivalence, rewards, partitions, and replay costs independently."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import re
import statistics
import sys
from fractions import Fraction
from pathlib import Path


def load(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes())


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


folder, out = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
name = "bio-delayed-lora-tail-learning"
config = folder / f"{name}.yaml"
driver = folder / "tail_learning.py"
result_file = folder / "learning.json"
rounds = folder / "learning-rounds.jsonl"
receipt = load(folder / f"{name}.json")
assert receipt["status"] == "success" and receipt["exit_code"] == 0
details = receipt["details"]
assert details["source_before"] == details["source_after"]
assert details["source_before"].split("|", 1)[0] == "0a3a0c4c1625f6ad75409f99dbd6d5e204f9a9f6"
assert sha(config) == details["config_sha256"] == details["config_sha256_after"]
check, = details["checks"]
assert check["status"] == "passed" and check["exit_code"] == 0
assert check["command"] == load(config)["tools"][name]["checks"][0]
assert sha(driver) == "bd2697b97bef7b385c179fede556bef21146c049632e3e75c028188e52c0a1e7" and sha(driver) in check["command"]
assert sha(folder / "tail_replay.py") == "3736d23c6112f9609a97bbef76c50540e8d72081242af28eb215c6acbf92ed1f" and "3736d23c6112f9609a97bbef76c50540e8d72081242af28eb215c6acbf92ed1f" in check["command"]
assert sha(result_file) in check["output_preview"] and sha(rounds) in check["output_preview"]

prior = load(folder / "validated-replay.json")
assert prior["result"]["passes_both_shapes"] == {"tail_cached": True, "tail_parallel": False}
learning = load(result_file)
records = [json.loads(line) for line in rounds.read_text().splitlines()]
assert records == learning["rows"] and len(records) == learning["train_updates"] == 64
assert learning["scored_actions"] == 64 * 4 * 4
seen = set()


def correct_label(pair):
    prompt, label = pair
    options = [Fraction(value) for value in re.findall(r"^[A-D]\. (\d+/\d+)$", prompt, re.M)]
    assert len(options) == len(set(options)) == 4
    key = tuple(sorted(options))
    assert key not in seen
    seen.add(key)
    assert options[label] == max(options)
    return label


matches = ("action_sha256", "behavior_sha256", "reward", "chosen_actions", "mixed_groups",
           "loss", "gradient_sha256", "weights_sha256", "optimizer_sha256")
mixed_updates = 0
for index, record in enumerate(records):
    assert record["iteration"] == index
    assert record["order"] == (["full", "tail"] if index % 2 == 0 else ["tail", "full"])
    gold = [correct_label(question) for question in record["questions"]]
    assert gold == record["gold"] and len(gold) == 4
    full, tail = (record["arms"][arm] for arm in ("full", "tail"))
    assert full["feature_bytes"] == 0 and tail["feature_bytes"] > 0
    assert all(full[key] == tail[key] for key in matches)
    chosen = full["chosen_actions"]
    assert len(chosen) == 16 and set(chosen) <= set(range(4))
    expected = [[int(chosen[4 * prompt + draw] == label) for draw in range(4)] for prompt, label in enumerate(gold)]
    assert expected == full["reward"]
    groups = sum(0 < sum(group) < 4 for group in expected)
    assert groups == full["mixed_groups"]
    mixed_updates += groups > 0
    for trial in (full, tail):
        assert trial["replay_and_step_ms"] > 0 and trial["collect_ms"] > 0
        assert math.isclose(trial["total_ms"], trial["collect_ms"] + trial["replay_and_step_ms"], rel_tol=1e-12)
    assert len(full["gradient_sha256"]) == len(full["weights_sha256"]) == 4
    assert len(full["optimizer_sha256"]) == 12
assert mixed_updates == learning["mixed_updates"]
assert len(learning["heldout"]) == 256
for item in learning["heldout"]:
    correct_label(item)
assert len(seen) == 512
assert learning["final"]["full"] == learning["final"]["tail"]
before, after = learning["initial"], learning["final"]["tail"]
for snapshot in (before, after):
    assert len(snapshot["gold_probabilities"]) == len(snapshot["correct_bits"]) == snapshot["queries"] == 256
    assert snapshot["correct_bits"].count("1") == snapshot["correct"]
    assert statistics.mean(snapshot["gold_probabilities"]) == snapshot["mean_gold_probability"]
    assert all(0 <= score <= 1 for score in snapshot["gold_probabilities"])
improvement = after["mean_gold_probability"] - before["mean_gold_probability"]
assert improvement == learning["observed_reward_gain"]
assert (mixed_updates >= 24 and improvement >= 0.05) == learning["positive_signal_gate"]
assert learning["updates_exact"]
for name_in_arm in ("full", "tail"):
    arm_rows = [record["arms"][name_in_arm]["total_ms"] for record in records]
    assert sum(arm_rows) == learning["total_ms"][name_in_arm]
    assert statistics.median(arm_rows) == learning["median_update_ms"][name_in_arm]
assert learning["total_speedup"] == learning["total_ms"]["full"] / learning["total_ms"]["tail"]

archive = {"multi_token_replay": prior, "one_token_learning": {"result": learning,
           "dsr_receipt": receipt, "driver_source": driver.read_text(), "source_sha256": sha(driver),
           "result_sha256": sha(result_file), "round_log_sha256": sha(rounds)},
           "learning_recount_source": Path(__file__).read_text()}
with out.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    json.dump(archive, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
    stream.write("\n")

"""Compare native cached and vectorized replay of a final-block LoRA policy."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import statistics
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter

import torch
from rich.console import Console
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from transformers.cache_utils import DynamicCache


SHAPES = ((4, 16), (8, 32))
MODES = ("full_cached", "tail_cached", "full_parallel", "tail_parallel")
ROUNDS = 3
TOP_K = 32
TEMPERATURE = 0.75
REVISION = "aafeb0fc6f22cbf0eaeed126eff8be45b0360a35"
CONSOLE = Console()


class RankOne(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, base, rng):
        super().__init__()
        self.base = base
        scale = math.sqrt(base.in_features)
        self.input = nn.Parameter(torch.randn((base.in_features, 1), generator=rng, device="cuda") / scale)
        self.output = nn.Parameter(torch.randn((1, base.out_features), generator=rng, device="cuda") * 0.05)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.base(x) + ((x.float() @ self.input) @ self.output).to(x.dtype)


@dataclass
class Episode:
    prompt: torch.Tensor
    actions: torch.Tensor
    support: torch.Tensor
    behavior: torch.Tensor
    indices: torch.Tensor
    saved: torch.Tensor | None

    def replay_tokens(self):
        return torch.cat((self.prompt, self.actions[:, :-1]), dim=1)


def capture(model, prompt, uniforms, eos, *, save):
    batch, prefix = prompt.shape
    steps = uniforms.shape[0]
    actions = torch.empty((batch, steps), dtype=torch.long, device="cuda")
    support = torch.empty((batch, steps, TOP_K), dtype=torch.long, device="cuda")
    behavior = torch.empty((batch, steps, TOP_K), dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
    indices = torch.empty((batch, steps), dtype=torch.long, device="cuda")
    saved = torch.empty((batch, prefix + steps - 1, model.config.hidden_size),
                        dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda") if save else None
    offset = 0

    def collect(_module, args, kwargs):
        nonlocal offset
        h = args[0]
        # The benchmark uses fully populated, fixed-length prompts and full attention.
        # On a backend that requires a mask, this recorder must fail closed.
        if kwargs["attention_mask"] is not None or h.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
            raise RuntimeError("cached boundary requires a native BF16 feature and an implicit causal mask")
        if saved is not None:
            saved[:, offset:offset + h.size(1)].copy_(h)
        offset += h.size(1)

    hook = model.model.layers[-1].register_forward_pre_hook(collect, with_kwargs=True)
    try:
        with torch.no_grad():
            cache = None
            current = prompt
            for step in range(steps):
                out = model.model(input_ids=current, past_key_values=cache, use_cache=True)
                cache = out.past_key_values
                logits = model.lm_head(out.last_hidden_state[:, -1]).float()
                sample_logits = logits if step == steps - 1 else logits.index_fill(1, eos, -torch.inf)
                top, ids = sample_logits.topk(TOP_K, dim=-1, sorted=True)
                cumulative = (top / TEMPERATURE).softmax(-1).cumsum(-1)
                choice = (uniforms[step, :, None] >= cumulative).sum(-1).clamp_max(TOP_K - 1)
                current = ids.gather(1, choice[:, None])
                support[:, step].copy_(ids)
                actions[:, step].copy_(current[:, 0])
                behavior[:, step].copy_(logits.gather(1, ids))
                indices[:, step].copy_(choice)
    finally:
        hook.remove()
    assert offset == prefix + steps - 1
    return Episode(prompt, actions, support, behavior, indices, saved)


def last_layer(model, prefix_features, offset, cache):
    position = torch.arange(offset, offset + prefix_features.size(1),
                            device=prefix_features.device).unsqueeze(0)
    embeddings = model.model.rotary_emb(prefix_features, position)
    out = model.model.layers[-1](prefix_features, attention_mask=None, position_ids=position,
                                 position_embeddings=embeddings, past_key_values=cache, use_cache=cache is not None)
    return model.model.norm(out)


def cached_scores(model, episode, *, tail, detach_prompt=False):
    prefix, steps = episode.prompt.size(1), episode.actions.size(1)
    cache = DynamicCache(config=model.config)
    chunks = []
    for step in range(steps):
        start = 0 if step == 0 else prefix + step - 1
        end = prefix + step
        if tail:
            if step == 0 and detach_prompt:
                with torch.no_grad():
                    last = last_layer(model, episode.saved[:, start:end], start, cache)[:, -1]
            else:
                last = last_layer(model, episode.saved[:, start:end], start, cache)[:, -1]
        else:
            tokens = episode.prompt if step == 0 else episode.actions[:, step - 1:step]
            out = model.model(input_ids=tokens, past_key_values=cache, use_cache=True)
            last = out.last_hidden_state[:, -1]
        chunks.append(model.lm_head(last).float().gather(1, episode.support[:, step]))
    return torch.stack(chunks, dim=1)


def parallel_scores(model, episode, *, tail):
    if tail:
        out = last_layer(model, episode.saved, 0, None)
    else:
        out = model.model(input_ids=episode.replay_tokens(), use_cache=False).last_hidden_state
    relevant = out[:, episode.prompt.size(1) - 1:]
    return model.lm_head(relevant).float().gather(2, episode.support)


def gradients(scores, episode, feedback, params):
    chosen = F.log_softmax(scores / TEMPERATURE, dim=-1).gather(2, episode.indices.unsqueeze(-1))
    objective = (chosen.squeeze(-1).sum(-1) * feedback).sum()
    out = torch.autograd.grad(objective, params)
    return tuple(gradient.detach() for gradient in out)


def nbytes(t):
    return t.numel() * t.element_size()


def digest(t):
    return hashlib.sha256(t.detach().cpu().contiguous().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest()


def run(model, prompt, uniforms, eos, mode, params):
    tail = mode.startswith("tail")
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    base_bytes = torch.cuda.memory_allocated()
    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
    start = perf_counter()
    ep = capture(model, prompt, uniforms, eos, save=tail)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    arrival = perf_counter()
    live_peak = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()
    before_feedback = torch.cuda.memory_allocated()
    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
    feedback = torch.linspace(-0.75, 0.95, prompt.size(0), dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
    if mode.endswith("parallel"):
        scores = parallel_scores(model, ep, tail=tail)
    else:
        scores = cached_scores(model, ep, tail=tail)
    grad = gradients(scores, ep, feedback, params)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    end = perf_counter()
    replay_peak = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()
    archive = {
        "collect_ms": (arrival - start) * 1000, "replay_ms": (end - arrival) * 1000,
        "total_ms": (end - start) * 1000, "feature_bytes": 0 if ep.saved is None else nbytes(ep.saved),
        "retained_common_bytes": sum(nbytes(x) for x in (ep.prompt, ep.actions, ep.support, ep.behavior, ep.indices)),
        "max_incremental_peak_bytes": max(live_peak, replay_peak) - base_bytes,
        "replay_incremental_peak_bytes": replay_peak - before_feedback,
        "actions_sha256": digest(ep.actions), "support_sha256": digest(ep.support),
        "behavior_sha256": digest(ep.behavior), "terminal_eos_actions": int(torch.isin(ep.actions[:, -1], eos).sum()),
        "behavior_logits_bitwise": torch.equal(ep.behavior, scores),
        "behavior_logits_max_abs": float((ep.behavior - scores.detach()).abs().max()),
    }
    assert not torch.isin(ep.actions[:, :-1], eos).any()
    return archive, scores.detach(), grad, ep, feedback


def errors(new, reference):
    per_factor = []
    for actual, expected in zip(new, reference, strict=True):
        absolute = (actual.double() - expected.double())
        norm = float(expected.double().norm())
        assert norm > 1e-8
        per_factor.append({"relative_frobenius": float(absolute.norm()) / norm,
                           "maximum_absolute": float(absolute.abs().max()),
                           "reference_norm": norm})
    return per_factor


def qualify(rows, scores, grads):
    reference, reference_grad = scores["full_cached"], grads["full_cached"]
    anchors = ("actions_sha256", "support_sha256", "behavior_sha256", "terminal_eos_actions")
    for key in anchors:
        assert len({row[key] for row in rows.values()}) == 1, key
    baseline_matches = rows["full_cached"]["behavior_logits_bitwise"]
    for mode in MODES:
        row = rows[mode]
        row["reference_logits_bitwise"] = torch.equal(scores[mode], reference)
        row["reference_logit_max_abs"] = float((scores[mode] - reference).abs().max())
        row["factor_gradient_errors"] = errors(grads[mode], reference_grad)
        gradient_pass = all(r["relative_frobenius"] <= 1e-6 and r["maximum_absolute"] <= 1e-7
                            for r in row["factor_gradient_errors"])
        row["eligible"] = baseline_matches and row["reference_logits_bitwise"] and gradient_pass


def decide(rows):
    result = {}
    for shape, observations in rows.items():
        summary = {}
        for mode in MODES:
            subject = [r["arms"][mode] for r in observations]
            summary[mode] = {"eligible": all(r["eligible"] for r in subject),
                             "median_collect_ms": statistics.median(r["collect_ms"] for r in subject),
                             "median_replay_ms": statistics.median(r["replay_ms"] for r in subject),
                             "median_total_ms": statistics.median(r["total_ms"] for r in subject),
                             "feature_bytes": subject[0]["feature_bytes"],
                             "max_incremental_peak_bytes": max(r["max_incremental_peak_bytes"] for r in subject)}
        eligible_full = [row for name, row in summary.items() if name.startswith("full") and row["eligible"]]
        for mode in MODES:
            row = summary[mode]
            row["replay_speedup_over_fastest_eligible_full"] = (
                min(x["median_replay_ms"] for x in eligible_full) / row["median_replay_ms"] if eligible_full else None)
            row["total_saving_over_fastest_eligible_full"] = (
                1.0 - row["median_total_ms"] / min(x["median_total_ms"] for x in eligible_full) if eligible_full else None)
            row["passes"] = (row["eligible"] and bool(eligible_full)
                             and row["replay_speedup_over_fastest_eligible_full"] >= 2.0
                             and row["total_saving_over_fastest_eligible_full"] >= 0.20)
        result[shape] = summary
    return result, {mode: all(summary[mode]["passes"] for summary in result.values())
                    for mode in MODES if mode.startswith("tail")}


def prompts(tokenizer, batch):
    rows = ["Evaluate the following product. Explain your result in plain text. "
            f"What is {20 + index} multiplied by {48 + index}? Answer:" for index in range(batch)]
    out = tokenizer(rows, add_special_tokens=False, return_tensors="pt", padding=True).to("cuda")
    assert bool(out.attention_mask.all())
    return out.input_ids


def draw(batch, steps, seed):
    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
    return torch.rand((steps, batch), generator=generator, device="cuda")


def main():
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    source, target, rounds_path = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(source, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(source, dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation="sdpa",
                                                use_safetensors=True, local_files_only=True,
                                                trust_remote_code=False).to("cuda").eval()
    model.requires_grad_(False)
    assert model.config.num_hidden_layers == 28 and not model.model.has_sliding_layers
    rng = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(92017)
    attention = model.model.layers[-1].self_attn
    attention.q_proj = RankOne(attention.q_proj, rng)
    attention.v_proj = RankOne(attention.v_proj, rng)
    params = (attention.q_proj.input, attention.q_proj.output, attention.v_proj.input, attention.v_proj.output)
    assert {id(p) for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad} == {id(p) for p in params}
    eos_ids = model.generation_config.eos_token_id
    eos = torch.tensor(eos_ids if isinstance(eos_ids, list) else [eos_ids], device="cuda")

    warm_prompt = prompts(tokenizer, 4)
    warm_uniforms = draw(4, 3, 899)
    for mode in MODES:
        run(model, warm_prompt, warm_uniforms, eos, mode, params)
    records = {}
    with rounds_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as round_archive:
        for shape_index, (batch, steps) in enumerate(SHAPES):
            key = f"{batch}x{steps}"
            records[key] = []
            prompt = prompts(tokenizer, batch)
            for trial in range(ROUNDS):
                seed = 1207 + trial
                uniforms = draw(batch, steps, seed)
                rotation = (trial + shape_index) % len(MODES)
                rows, scores, grads, episodes = {}, {}, {}, {}
                for mode in MODES[rotation:] + MODES[:rotation]:
                    row, values, gradient, episode, feedback = run(model, prompt, uniforms, eos, mode, params)
                    rows[mode], scores[mode], grads[mode], episodes[mode] = row, values, gradient, episode
                qualify(rows, scores, grads)
                warning = None
                if trial == 0:
                    ep = episodes["tail_cached"]
                    detached = cached_scores(model, ep, tail=True, detach_prompt=True)
                    detached_grad = gradients(detached, ep, feedback, params)
                    detached_errors = errors(detached_grad, grads["tail_cached"])
                    warning = {"detaching_prompt_logits_unchanged": torch.equal(detached.detach(), scores["tail_cached"]),
                               "tail_vs_detached_prompt_errors": detached_errors}
                    assert warning["detaching_prompt_logits_unchanged"]
                    assert max(r["relative_frobenius"] for r in detached_errors[2:]) > 1e-3
                merged = {"shape": key, "round": trial, "seed": seed, "prefill_length": prompt.size(1),
                          "arms": rows, "prompt_detach_counterexample": warning}
                records[key].append(merged)
                round_archive.write(json.dumps(merged, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                round_archive.flush()
                CONSOLE.print_json(data={"shape": key, "trial": trial,
                                         "eligible": {m: rows[m]["eligible"] for m in MODES},
                                         "total_ms": {m: rows[m]["total_ms"] for m in MODES}})
    summary, gate = decide(records)
    result = {"model_revision": REVISION, "adapters": ["q.input", "q.output", "v.input", "v.output"],
              "trainable_scalars": sum(x.numel() for x in params), "rows": records,
              "summary": summary, "passes_both_shapes": gate,
              "run_scope": "One delayed, signed coefficient per trajectory; same frozen Qwen and one rank-one Q/V adapter in the final block. Four paths tested in the same invocation. The objective is the conditional log likelihood on the actual sampler support. Timing ends at gradients.",
              "runtime": {"gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name(), "torch": torch.__version__}}
    CONSOLE.print_json(data={"summary": summary, "passes_both_shapes": gate})
    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)


if __name__ == "__main__":

"""Verify provenance and independently tally the tail-replay engineering gate."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import statistics
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def load(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes())


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


folder, artifact = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
name = "bio-delayed-lora-tail-replay"
settings = folder / f"{name}.yaml"
driver = folder / "tail_replay.py"
raw = folder / "result.json"
round_file = folder / "rounds.jsonl"
receipt = load(folder / f"{name}.json")
assert receipt["status"] == "success" and receipt["exit_code"] == 0
details = receipt["details"]
assert details["source_after"] == details["source_before"]
assert details["source_before"].split("|", 1)[0] == "0a3a0c4c1625f6ad75409f99dbd6d5e204f9a9f6"
assert details["config_sha256"] == details["config_sha256_after"] == sha(settings)
check, = details["checks"]
assert check["status"] == "passed" and check["exit_code"] == 0
assert check["command"] == load(settings)["tools"][name]["checks"][0]
assert sha(driver) == "3736d23c6112f9609a97bbef76c50540e8d72081242af28eb215c6acbf92ed1f" and sha(driver) in check["command"]
assert sha(raw) in check["output_preview"] and sha(round_file) in check["output_preview"]

study = load(raw)
rounds = [json.loads(line) for line in round_file.read_text().splitlines()]
assert set(study["rows"]) == {"4x16", "8x32"} and len(rounds) == 6
assert study["trainable_scalars"] == 4864 and len(study["adapters"]) == 4
assert study["model_revision"] == "aafeb0fc6f22cbf0eaeed126eff8be45b0360a35"
modes = ("full_cached", "tail_cached", "full_parallel", "tail_parallel")
expected_pass = dict.fromkeys(modes[1::2], True)
for shape, cohort in study["rows"].items():
    assert [r for r in rounds if r["shape"] == shape] == cohort
    assert len(cohort) == 3 and [item["seed"] for item in cohort] == [1207, 1208, 1209]
    batch, steps = map(int, shape.split("x"))
    for index, record in enumerate(cohort):
        assert record["round"] == index
        rows = record["arms"]
        assert set(rows) == set(modes)
        for key in ("actions_sha256", "support_sha256", "behavior_sha256", "terminal_eos_actions"):
            assert len({r[key] for r in rows.values()}) == 1
        for mode, arm in rows.items():
            expected = batch * (record["prefill_length"] + steps - 1) * 1536 * 2 if mode.startswith("tail") else 0
            assert arm["feature_bytes"] == expected
            assert 0 < arm["collect_ms"] < arm["total_ms"]
            assert math.isclose(arm["collect_ms"] + arm["replay_ms"], arm["total_ms"], rel_tol=1e-12)
            assert len(arm["factor_gradient_errors"]) == 4
            qualifies = rows["full_cached"]["behavior_logits_bitwise"] and arm["reference_logits_bitwise"]
            for r in arm["factor_gradient_errors"]:
                assert r["reference_norm"] > 1e-8
                qualifies = qualifies and r["relative_frobenius"] <= 1e-6 and r["maximum_absolute"] <= 1e-7
            assert qualifies == arm["eligible"]
            assert arm["behavior_logits_bitwise"] == (arm["behavior_logits_max_abs"] == 0)
            assert arm["reference_logits_bitwise"] == (arm["reference_logit_max_abs"] == 0)
        if index == 0:
            witness = record["prompt_detach_counterexample"]
            assert witness["detaching_prompt_logits_unchanged"]
            assert len(witness["tail_vs_detached_prompt_errors"]) == 4
            assert max(r["relative_frobenius"] for r in witness["tail_vs_detached_prompt_errors"][2:]) > 1e-3
        else:
            assert record["prompt_detach_counterexample"] is None
    summaries = study["summary"][shape]
    eligible = {}
    for mode in modes:
        summary = summaries[mode]
        arms = [r["arms"][mode] for r in cohort]
        eligible[mode] = all(r["eligible"] for r in arms)
        assert eligible[mode] == summary["eligible"]
        assert all(arm["feature_bytes"] == summary["feature_bytes"] for arm in arms)
        for phase in ("collect", "replay", "total"):
            assert statistics.median(r[f"{phase}_ms"] for r in arms) == summary[f"median_{phase}_ms"]
    viable = [summaries[mode] for mode in modes if mode.startswith("full") and eligible[mode]]
    for mode, summary in summaries.items():
        speed = min(r["median_replay_ms"] for r in viable) / summary["median_replay_ms"] if viable else None
        saving = 1 - summary["median_total_ms"] / min(r["median_total_ms"] for r in viable) if viable else None
        passed = eligible[mode] and bool(viable) and speed >= 2 and saving >= 0.2
        assert speed == summary["replay_speedup_over_fastest_eligible_full"]
        assert saving == summary["total_saving_over_fastest_eligible_full"]
        assert passed == summary["passes"]
        if mode in expected_pass:
            expected_pass[mode] &= passed
assert expected_pass == study["passes_both_shapes"]

archive = {"result": study, "dsr_receipt": receipt, "source_sha256": sha(driver),
           "driver_source": driver.read_text(), "result_sha256": sha(raw),
           "round_log_sha256": sha(round_file), "recount_source": Path(__file__).read_text()}
with artifact.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    json.dump(archive, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
    stream.write("\n")

"""Compare paired one-token policy updates with full versus captured tail replay."""
import json
import random
import statistics
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter

import torch
from rich.console import Console
from torch.nn import functional as F
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

from tail_replay import RankOne, REVISION, digest, last_layer, nbytes


UPDATES, GROUPS, DRAWS, HOLDOUT = 64, 4, 4, 256
ROOT_SEED = 89119


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Arm:
    query: RankOne
    value: RankOne
    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer

    def params(self):
        return self.query.input, self.query.output, self.value.input, self.value.output


def make_arm(attention):
    rng = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(ROOT_SEED)
    q, v = RankOne(attention.q_proj, rng), RankOne(attention.v_proj, rng)
    observed = (q.input, q.output, v.input, v.output)
    return Arm(q, v, torch.optim.AdamW(observed, lr=0.003, weight_decay=0.0))


def activate(attention, arm):
    attention.q_proj = arm.query
    attention.v_proj = arm.value


def describe(rng, known):
    while True:
        pairs, fractions = [], []
        while len(pairs) < 4:
            n, d = rng.randint(10, 99), rng.randint(10, 99)
            value = Fraction(n, d)
            if value not in fractions:
                pairs.append((n, d))
                fractions.append(value)
        signature = tuple(sorted(fractions))
        if signature not in known:
            known.add(signature)
            break
    choices = "\n".join(f"{letter}. {n}/{d}" for letter, (n, d) in zip("ABCD", pairs, strict=True))
    return f"Choose the fraction with the largest numerical value.\n{choices}\nRespond with a single letter.\nAnswer:", fractions.index(max(fractions))


def encode(tokenizer, rows):
    prompts, targets = zip(*rows, strict=True)
    batch = tokenizer(list(prompts), add_special_tokens=False, return_tensors="pt", padding=True).to("cuda")
    assert bool(batch.attention_mask.all())
    return batch.input_ids, torch.tensor(targets, device="cuda")


def score_head(hidden, selected_weights):
    return hidden[:, -1].float() @ selected_weights.T


def native(model, input_ids):
    return model.model(input_ids=input_ids, use_cache=False).last_hidden_state


@torch.no_grad()
def measure_reward(model, tokenizer, weights, heldout):
    probs, flags = [], []
    for start in range(0, len(heldout), 16):
        input_ids, correct = encode(tokenizer, heldout[start:start + 16])
        logits = score_head(native(model, input_ids), weights)
        probs.extend(logits.softmax(-1).gather(1, correct[:, None])[:, 0].tolist())
        flags.extend((logits.argmax(-1) == correct).tolist())
    return {"queries": len(heldout), "correct": sum(flags), "mean_gold_probability": statistics.mean(probs),
            "gold_probabilities": probs, "correct_bits": "".join("1" if flag else "0" for flag in flags)}


def adam_digest(optimizer, parameters):
    tensors = []
    for parameter in parameters:
        state = optimizer.state[parameter]
        for key in ("step", "exp_avg", "exp_avg_sq"):
            tensors.append(digest(state[key]))
    return tensors


def update(model, attention, arm, weights, input_ids, correct, randoms, *, tail):
    activate(attention, arm)
    cached = None

    def capture(_module, args, kwargs):
        nonlocal cached
        assert kwargs["attention_mask"] is None
        cached = args[0].clone()

    arm.optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    start = perf_counter()
    hook = model.model.layers[-1].register_forward_pre_hook(capture, with_kwargs=True) if tail else None
    try:
        with torch.no_grad():
            behavior = score_head(native(model, input_ids), weights)
            probabilities = behavior.softmax(-1).cumsum(-1)
            actions = (randoms[:, None] >= probabilities).sum(-1).clamp_max(3)
            reward = (actions == correct).float().view(GROUPS, DRAWS)
            centered = (reward - reward.mean(1, keepdim=True)).view(-1)
    finally:
        if hook is not None:
            hook.remove()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    feedback = perf_counter()
    final = last_layer(model, cached, 0, None) if tail else native(model, input_ids)
    logits = score_head(final, weights)
    torch.testing.assert_close(logits, behavior, atol=0, rtol=0)
    chosen = F.log_softmax(logits, -1).gather(1, actions[:, None])[:, 0]
    loss = -(chosen * centered).mean()
    loss.backward()
    arm.optimizer.step()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    finish = perf_counter()
    parameters = arm.params()
    return {"collect_ms": 1000 * (feedback - start), "replay_and_step_ms": 1000 * (finish - feedback),
            "total_ms": 1000 * (finish - start), "feature_bytes": nbytes(cached) if cached is not None else 0,
            "action_sha256": digest(actions), "behavior_sha256": digest(behavior),
            "reward": reward.int().tolist(), "chosen_actions": actions.tolist(),
            "mixed_groups": int(((reward.sum(1) > 0) & (reward.sum(1) < DRAWS)).sum()),
            "loss": float(loss.detach()),
            "gradient_sha256": [digest(p.grad) for p in parameters],
            "weights_sha256": [digest(p) for p in parameters],
            "optimizer_sha256": adam_digest(arm.optimizer, parameters)}


def main():
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    snapshot, output, journal = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(snapshot, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
    label_ids = [tokenizer.encode(" " + c, add_special_tokens=False) for c in "ABCD"]
    assert all(len(row) == 1 for row in label_ids) and len({row[0] for row in label_ids}) == 4
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(snapshot, dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation="sdpa",
                                                use_safetensors=True, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False).to("cuda").eval()
    model.requires_grad_(False)
    weights = model.lm_head.weight[[row[0] for row in label_ids]].float().detach().contiguous()
    attention = model.model.layers[-1].self_attn
    arms = {name: make_arm(attention) for name in ("full", "tail")}
    assert all(torch.equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(arms["full"].params(), arms["tail"].params(), strict=True))
    known = set()
    draw_train = random.Random(ROOT_SEED + 100_000)
    draw_holdout = random.Random(ROOT_SEED + 200_000)
    train = [describe(draw_train, known) for _ in range(UPDATES * GROUPS)]
    heldout = [describe(draw_holdout, known) for _ in range(HOLDOUT)]
    activate(attention, arms["full"])
    before = measure_reward(model, tokenizer, weights, heldout)
    uniforms = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(ROOT_SEED + 300_000)
    stages = []
    console = Console()
    with journal.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as checkpoint:
        for iteration in range(UPDATES):
            group = train[iteration * GROUPS:(iteration + 1) * GROUPS]
            input_ids, gold = encode(tokenizer, group)
            ids, correct = input_ids.repeat_interleave(DRAWS, 0), gold.repeat_interleave(DRAWS)
            randoms = torch.rand(GROUPS * DRAWS, generator=uniforms, device="cuda")
            order = ("full", "tail") if iteration % 2 == 0 else ("tail", "full")
            arms_data = {name: update(model, attention, arms[name], weights, ids, correct, randoms, tail=name == "tail")
                         for name in order}
            keys = ("action_sha256", "behavior_sha256", "reward", "chosen_actions", "mixed_groups",
                    "loss", "gradient_sha256", "weights_sha256", "optimizer_sha256")
            for key in keys:
                assert arms_data["full"][key] == arms_data["tail"][key], key
            row = {"iteration": iteration, "order": order, "questions": group, "gold": gold.tolist(),
                   "arms": arms_data}
            stages.append(row)
            checkpoint.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            checkpoint.flush()
            if (iteration + 1) % 8 == 0:
                console.print_json(data={"updates": iteration + 1, "mixed_groups": sum(s["arms"]["full"]["mixed_groups"] for s in stages)})
    final = {}
    for name, arm in arms.items():
        activate(attention, arm)
        final[name] = measure_reward(model, tokenizer, weights, heldout)
    assert final["full"] == final["tail"]
    total_ms = {name: sum(row["arms"][name]["total_ms"] for row in stages) for name in arms}
    medians_ms = {name: statistics.median(row["arms"][name]["total_ms"] for row in stages) for name in arms}
    improvement = final["tail"]["mean_gold_probability"] - before["mean_gold_probability"]
    mixed_updates = sum(row["arms"]["full"]["mixed_groups"] > 0 for row in stages)
    report = {"scope": "Single-seed paired one-token policy-gradient pilot with four fixed tokens and verifiable fraction-order reward.",
              "model_revision": REVISION, "train_updates": UPDATES, "scored_actions": UPDATES * GROUPS * DRAWS,
              "initial": before, "final": final, "heldout": heldout, "mixed_updates": mixed_updates,
              "observed_reward_gain": improvement, "positive_signal_gate": mixed_updates >= 24 and improvement >= 0.05,
              "total_ms": total_ms, "median_update_ms": medians_ms, "total_speedup": total_ms["full"] / total_ms["tail"],
              "updates_exact": True, "rows": stages, "runtime": {"gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name(), "torch": torch.__version__}}
    console.print_json(data={key: report[key] for key in ("mixed_updates", "observed_reward_gain", "positive_signal_gate", "total_ms", "total_speedup")})
    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as file:
        json.dump(report, file, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Compare exact replay with a retained generation graph across the original cohorts."""
import json
import statistics
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter

import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

from tail_replay import (
    CONSOLE, ROUNDS, SHAPES, TEMPERATURE, TOP_K, Episode, RankOne, digest,
    draw, errors, gradients, prompts, run,
)


def live_graph(model, prompt, uniforms, eos):
    cache = None
    current = prompt
    actions, support, indices, scores = [], [], [], []
    for step, randoms in enumerate(uniforms):
        output = model.model(input_ids=current, past_key_values=cache, use_cache=True)
        cache = output.past_key_values
        logits = model.lm_head(output.last_hidden_state[:, -1]).float()
        with torch.no_grad():
            sampling = logits if step == len(uniforms) - 1 else logits.index_fill(1, eos, -torch.inf)
            top, ids = sampling.topk(TOP_K, dim=-1, sorted=True)
            cumulative = (top / TEMPERATURE).softmax(-1).cumsum(-1)
            choice = (randoms[:, None] >= cumulative).sum(-1).clamp_max(TOP_K - 1)
            current = ids.gather(1, choice[:, None])
        actions.append(current[:, 0])
        support.append(ids)
        indices.append(choice)
        scores.append(logits.gather(1, ids))
    stacked = torch.stack(scores, dim=1)
    return Episode(prompt, torch.stack(actions, dim=1), torch.stack(support, dim=1),
                   stacked.detach(), torch.stack(indices, dim=1), None), stacked


def timed(model, prompt, uniforms, eos, params, mode):
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    baseline = torch.cuda.memory_allocated()
    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
    start = perf_counter()
    if mode != "retained":
        row, logits, gradient, episode, _ = run(model, prompt, uniforms, eos, mode, params)
        # The replay helper records precisely the components live at feedback.
        retained = row["retained_common_bytes"] - episode.prompt.numel() * episode.prompt.element_size()
        return {**row, "waiting_bytes": retained + row["feature_bytes"]}, logits, gradient
    episode, scores = live_graph(model, prompt, uniforms, eos)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    arrival = perf_counter()
    waiting = torch.cuda.memory_allocated() - baseline
    feedback = torch.linspace(-0.75, 0.95, prompt.size(0), dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
    gradient = gradients(scores, episode, feedback, params)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    end = perf_counter()
    return {
        "collect_ms": 1000 * (arrival - start), "replay_ms": 1000 * (end - arrival),
        "total_ms": 1000 * (end - start), "waiting_bytes": waiting,
        "max_incremental_peak_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() - baseline,
        "actions_sha256": digest(episode.actions), "support_sha256": digest(episode.support),
        "behavior_sha256": digest(episode.behavior), "behavior_logits_bitwise": True,
    }, scores.detach(), gradient


def main():
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    snapshot, out, log = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(snapshot, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(snapshot, dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation="sdpa",
                                                use_safetensors=True, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False).to("cuda").eval()
    model.requires_grad_(False)
    assert model.config.num_hidden_layers == 28 and not model.model.has_sliding_layers
    rng = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(92017)
    attention = model.model.layers[-1].self_attn
    attention.q_proj = RankOne(attention.q_proj, rng)
    attention.v_proj = RankOne(attention.v_proj, rng)
    params = (attention.q_proj.input, attention.q_proj.output, attention.v_proj.input, attention.v_proj.output)
    raw_eos = model.generation_config.eos_token_id
    eos = torch.tensor(raw_eos if isinstance(raw_eos, list) else [raw_eos], device="cuda")
    modes = ("full_cached", "tail_cached", "retained")
    for mode in modes:
        timed(model, prompts(tokenizer, 4), draw(4, 3, 899), eos, params, mode)
    records = []
    with log.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as journal:
        for index, (batch, steps) in enumerate(SHAPES):
            prompt = prompts(tokenizer, batch)
            for trial in range(ROUNDS):
                seed = 1207 + trial
                randoms = draw(batch, steps, seed)
                rotation = (index + trial) % len(modes)
                order = modes[rotation:] + modes[:rotation]
                result = {mode: timed(model, prompt, randoms, eos, params, mode) for mode in order}
                reference, ref_scores, ref_grad = result["full_cached"]
                for row, scores, gradient in result.values():
                    row["same_trajectory"] = all(row[key] == reference[key] for key in
                                                  ("actions_sha256", "support_sha256", "behavior_sha256"))
                    row["reference_logits_bitwise"] = torch.equal(scores, ref_scores)
                    row["gradient_bitwise"] = all(torch.equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(gradient, ref_grad, strict=True))
                    row["factor_gradient_errors"] = errors(gradient, ref_grad)
                    row["exact"] = (row["same_trajectory"] and row["reference_logits_bitwise"]
                                    and row["gradient_bitwise"] and row["behavior_logits_bitwise"])
                record = {"shape": f"{batch}x{steps}", "trial": trial, "seed": seed, "order": order,
                          "arms": {mode: result[mode][0] for mode in modes}}
                records.append(record)
                journal.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                journal.flush()
                CONSOLE.print_json(data={"shape": record["shape"], "trial": trial,
                                         "exact": {mode: record["arms"][mode]["exact"] for mode in modes}})
    summary = {}
    for batch, steps in SHAPES:
        shape = f"{batch}x{steps}"
        selected = [row["arms"] for row in records if row["shape"] == shape]
        summary[shape] = {}
        for mode in modes:
            rows = [row[mode] for row in selected]
            summary[shape][mode] = {
                "exact_rounds": sum(row["exact"] for row in rows),
                **{key: statistics.median(row[key] for row in rows) for key in
                   ("collect_ms", "replay_ms", "total_ms", "waiting_bytes", "max_incremental_peak_bytes")},
            }
    CONSOLE.print_json(data=summary)
    with out.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump({"rows": records, "summary": summary, "runtime": torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
                   "scope": "Same-policy multi-token gradient and device retention; no optimizer effects or waits."},
                  stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Independently verify the retained-graph cohort and end-to-end decision."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import statistics
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes())


def hash_file(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


folder, output = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
name = "bio-delayed-lora-retained-graph"
receipt = read(folder / f"{name}.json")
details = receipt["details"]
config = folder / f"{name}.yaml"
driver = folder / "retained_graph.py"
result_file = folder / "retained.json"
log = folder / "retained-rounds.jsonl"
assert receipt["status"] == "success" and receipt["exit_code"] == 0
assert details["source_before"] == details["source_after"]
assert details["source_after"].split("|")[0] == "0a3a0c4c1625f6ad75409f99dbd6d5e204f9a9f6"
assert hash_file(config) == details["config_sha256"] == details["config_sha256_after"]
check, = details["checks"]
assert check["status"] == "passed" and check["exit_code"] == 0
assert check["command"] == read(config)["tools"][name]["checks"][0]
assert hash_file(driver) == "a59250b34dd055cd977f2a79bfcdd3003b4e5857e57696717f68f7c8c9ec23ac" and hash_file(driver) in check["command"]
assert hash_file(folder / "tail_replay.py") == "3736d23c6112f9609a97bbef76c50540e8d72081242af28eb215c6acbf92ed1f" and hash_file(folder / "tail_replay.py") in check["command"]
assert hash_file(result_file) in check["output_preview"] and hash_file(log) in check["output_preview"]

result = read(result_file)
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in log.read_text().splitlines()]
assert rows == result["rows"]
assert len(rows) == 6
modes = ["full_cached", "tail_cached", "retained"]
matches = ("actions_sha256", "support_sha256", "behavior_sha256")
costs = ("collect_ms", "replay_ms", "total_ms", "waiting_bytes", "max_incremental_peak_bytes")
qualification = {}
prior = read(folder / "validated-learning.json")
original = prior["multi_token_replay"]["result"]["rows"]
for shape_index, shape in enumerate(("4x16", "8x32")):
    grouped = [row for row in rows if row["shape"] == shape]
    assert len(grouped) == 3
    for trial, record in enumerate(grouped):
        assert record["trial"] == trial and record["seed"] == 1207 + trial
        shift = (trial + shape_index) % 3
        assert record["order"] == modes[shift:] + modes[:shift]
        assert set(record["arms"]) == set(modes)
        full = record["arms"]["full_cached"]
        anchor = original[shape][trial]["arms"]["full_cached"]
        assert all(full[key] == anchor[key] for key in matches)
        for row in record["arms"].values():
            same = all(row[key] == full[key] for key in matches)
            assert same == row["same_trajectory"]
            assert len(row["factor_gradient_errors"]) == 4
            exact_gradient = all(err["relative_frobenius"] == 0 == err["maximum_absolute"]
                                 for err in row["factor_gradient_errors"])
            assert exact_gradient == row["gradient_bitwise"]
            assert row["exact"] == (same and exact_gradient and row["reference_logits_bitwise"] and row["behavior_logits_bitwise"])
            assert math.isclose(row["total_ms"], row["collect_ms"] + row["replay_ms"], rel_tol=1e-12)
            assert 0 < row["waiting_bytes"] <= row["max_incremental_peak_bytes"]
    summary = result["summary"][shape]
    for mode, stats in summary.items():
        arms = [row["arms"][mode] for row in grouped]
        assert stats["exact_rounds"] == sum(arm["exact"] for arm in arms)
        assert all(stats[key] == statistics.median(arm[key] for arm in arms) for key in costs)
    tail, kept = (summary[mode] for mode in ("tail_cached", "retained"))
    qualification[shape] = {
        "exact": all(row["exact_rounds"] == 3 for row in summary.values()),
        "retained_to_tail_waiting_bytes": kept["waiting_bytes"] / tail["waiting_bytes"],
        "tail_to_retained_wall_time": tail["total_ms"] / kept["total_ms"],
    }
    gate = qualification[shape]
    gate["passes"] = (gate["exact"] and gate["retained_to_tail_waiting_bytes"] >= 2
                      and gate["tail_to_retained_wall_time"] <= 1.10)
prior["retained_graph_pressure_test"] = {
    "result": result, "gate_recount": qualification, "dsr_receipt": receipt,
    "driver_source": driver.read_text(), "driver_sha256": hash_file(driver),
    "result_sha256": hash_file(result_file), "round_log_sha256": hash_file(log),
    "recount_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
for key, tool in (
    ("multi_token_replay", "bio-delayed-lora-tail-replay"),
    ("one_token_learning", "bio-delayed-lora-tail-learning"),
    ("retained_graph_pressure_test", name),
):
    config_path = folder / f"{tool}.yaml"
    record = prior[key]
    assert hash_file(config_path) == record["dsr_receipt"]["details"]["config_sha256"]
    record["dsr_config_source"] = config_path.read_text()
with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    json.dump(prior, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
    stream.write("\n")
